notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hides unit info in battles during tutorials
[*] Hides starter dice panel when sorting the units
[*] Updates re-roll prices to be based on total amount of items left
[*] Update small heal icon to be a smaller heart to contrast better with the half-heal icon
[/list]

notes.title: Try the big demo update for Dicey Bugs, a turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides
notes.notes:
Dicey Bugs is a roguelike, turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides of the battles. A new demo is live now!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/try-the-big-demo-update-for-dicey-bugs-a-turn-based-deckbuilder-where-you-control-both-sides/

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Adds new "Scare" action for die faces and consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds tutorials for Player Party and Run Completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds tutorial titles to the tutorial boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a notification animation to the shop once you are able to purchase an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds navigation to show which map you're currently on.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a tooltip to the speed settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite & Boss units now drop more coins.[/p][/*][*][p]Consumables are now limited to 5, rather than 10.[/p][/*][*][p]The consumables bar is now fully shown, regardless of how many you have.[/p][/*][*][p]The first ever dice roll is now predetermined to help teach players.[/p][/*][*][p]Coin rewards have been removed from the tutorial battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Player dice no longer get grayed out when they are ineffective.[/p][/*][*][p]The difficulty curve has been slightly modified.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where the KO animation was not always playing correctly on fast mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes controller support breaking during loot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes consumables not triggering a "Miss" when the action is unusable[/p][/*][/list]
